description: Ownership notes stating that the codex (מצחף) belongs to Shelomo b. Mevasser b. Sahl ha-ʿAnī. A later ownership note added below the original text states that the book now belongs to Sibāʿ b. Moshe ha-Levi and his two sons, Efrayim and Menashshe. Writing exercises with the beginning of the Hebrew alphabet in the top margin. Solomon b. Mevasser b. Sahl ha-ʿAnī is also known from T-S 24.7 (dated 1003–4 CE), which is a Qaraite ketubba for his marriage to his cousin. (Information from CUDL.)
description_he: טקסט פרא-ספרותי בHebrew, Judaeo-Arabic. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
